name: UBO identification procedure
description: Documented procedure to unwind ownership to natural persons; trigger thresholds; evidence retained.

name: PEP + sanctions screening
description: Counterparties screened at onboarding + periodically + on change; daily list refresh.

name: Cash-handling policy + threshold log
description: Documented threshold (≥10k EUR EU); CDD trigger; reporting log.

name: Record-keeping cycle (≥5 yr)
description: All CDD, monitoring, screening, training and incident records retained for the regulatory minimum.

name: STR / SAR pathway
description: Documented escalation path from suspicion to FIU / NCA; templates retained; quarterly drill.

name: Baseline FCP training
description: 30-minute baseline at induction; annual refresher; attendance log.

name: Named compliance responsibility
description: One named individual (owner / director / manager) accountable for FCP. Documented in role description.
